title: Discovery of novel danshensu derivatives bearing pyrazolone moiety as potential anti-ischemic stroke agents with antioxidant activity.
authors: Li, Yi; Luo, Yunchun; Wang, Jing; Shi, Hao; Liao, Jun; Wang, Yan; Chen, Zhesheng; Xiong, Liyan; Zhang, Chuan; Wang, Tingfang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究抗缺血性中风的新型丹参素衍生物，涉及Keap1蛋白与配体小分子的分子对接，但核心是药物化学与氧化应激机制，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，亦无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Neuroprotective agents with attenuation of oxidative stress by directly scavenging ROS and indirectly through Keap1-Nrf2 signal pathway activation may be a promising cerebral ischemic stroke therapeutic strategy. In this study, a series of novel danshensu derivatives bearing pyrazolone moieties with dual antioxidant effects were synthesized for the treatment of ischemic stroke. Most compounds exhibited considerable DPPH free radical scavenging ability and neuroprotective activity against H(2)O(2)-induced oxidative injury in PC12 neuronal cells, without cytotoxicity. Among these target compounds, Del03 displayed the strongest dose-dependent neuroprotective activity in vitro, directly downregulated intracellular ROS levels, and improved the oxidative stress parameters MDA, SOD, and LDH. Del03 also promoted Nrf2 translocation to the nucleus, subsequently increasing the expression of the Nrf2 downstream target HO-1. Molecular docking analysis revealed that Del03 could anchor to the key site of Keap1. Del03 possessed the ability to penetrate blood-brain barrier and displayed good ability on pharmacokinetic properties in rats Del03 possessed good BBB penetration efficiency, suitable pharmacokinetic properties in vivo. Del03 reduced cerebral infarction volume and promoted neurological function in a middle cerebral artery occlusion (MCAO) mouse model at a dose of 20 mg/kg by intravenous injection. The characteristics of Del03 detailed in this study demonstrate its potential as a therapeutic agent in the treatment of ischemic stroke.
abstract_zh: 通过直接清除活性氧（ROS）以及间接激活Keap1-Nrf2信号通路来减轻氧化应激的神经保护剂，可能是一种有前景的脑缺血性卒中治疗策略。本研究合成了一系列带有吡唑啉酮部分的新型丹参素衍生物，其具有双重抗氧化作用，用于缺血性卒中的治疗。大多数化合物表现出显著的DPPH自由基清除能力，并对H(2)O(2)诱导的PC12神经元细胞氧化损伤具有神经保护活性，且无细胞毒性。在这些目标化合物中，Del03在体外显示出最强的剂量依赖性神经保护活性，直接下调细胞内ROS水平，并改善氧化应激参数MDA、SOD和LDH。Del03还促进Nrf2向细胞核转位，随后增加Nrf2下游靶基因HO-1的表达。分子对接分析显示，Del03可锚定于Keap1的关键位点。Del03具有穿透血脑屏障的能力，并在大鼠中表现出良好的药代动力学特性。Del03具有良好的血脑屏障穿透效率及适宜的体内药代动力学性质。在中大脑动脉闭塞（MCAO）小鼠模型中，以20 mg/kg剂量静脉注射，Del03减少了脑梗死体积并促进了神经功能恢复。本研究详述的Del03特性表明其作为缺血性卒中治疗药物的潜力。
